output.rationale: The gold accurately compares the Thai confirmation requirements with the EMPEROR-Preserved analysis limitation. The trial authors explicitly could not exclude white-coat hypertension and identified other unresolved pseudoresistance confounders. “Could not exclude” does not assert that any participant had pseudoresistance. The subgroup therefore cannot automatically be called confirmed true resistant hypertension. No material source conflict or unresolved text-extraction issue affects this decision.
